• Several typo’s in class / method names:

•     Wrong base method name inside the user function (`GetVal` → `Get_y`).  
•     C-style container calls (`.front()`) replaced with Python indexing `[0]`.  
•     Many numerical objects (`ChVector3d`) replaced with the up-to-date Python binding name `ChVectorD`.  
•     A few run-time logical errors (wrong lists, wrong number of constrained DOFs, …) removed.

```python
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Beam mechanism – fixed version
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Demonstrates: Cosserat IGA beam, Euler beams, body-to-beam constraints,
#                rigid crank driven by a speed law, Irrlicht visualisation.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import math as m
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.pardisomkl as mklsolver
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import os

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  User-defined angular–speed profile for the crank motor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ChFunctionMyFun(chrono.ChFunction):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    # Chrono 8.x expects Get_y() in Python
    def Get_y(self, t):
        """
        Piece-wise continuous angular speed [rad/s].
        """
        if t > 0.5:
            return chrono.CH_PI                     #  π  [rad/s]
        else:
            # smooth half-cosine ramp up to   t = 0.5
            return -chrono.CH_PI * (1.0 - m.cos(chrono.CH_PI * t / 0.3)) / 2.0


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Create the simulation system
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()           # non-smooth contact model (still OK for FEA)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Geometry definition
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
L = 1.2
H = 0.4
K = 0.07

vA = chrono.ChVectorD(0,   0, 0)
vC = chrono.ChVectorD(L,   0, 0)
vB = chrono.ChVectorD(L,  -H, 0)
vG = chrono.ChVectorD(L-K,-H, 0)
vd = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1e-4)          # very small Z offset – avoids zero thickness in Z

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Ground (truss) – just a fixed, visual reference body
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
body_truss = chrono.ChBody()
body_truss.SetBodyFixed(True)
sys.Add(body_truss)

# simple visualisation for the ground
box_truss = chrono.ChVisualShapeBox(chrono.ChVectorD(0.015, 0.125, 0.075))
body_truss.AddVisualShape(box_truss,
                          chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(-0.01, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Rigid crank driven by a rotational speed motor
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
body_crank = chrono.ChBody()
body_crank.SetPos((vC + vG) * 0.5)
sys.Add(body_crank)

box_crank = chrono.ChVisualShapeBox(chrono.ChVectorD(K*0.5, 0.025, 0.015))
body_crank.AddVisualShape(box_crank)

motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()
motor.Initialize(body_truss, body_crank,
                 chrono.ChFrameD(vG, chrono.QUNIT))   # revolute at point G
motor.SetSpeedFunction(ChFunctionMyFun())
sys.Add(motor)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Build the FEA mesh
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mesh = fea.ChMesh()

# --- Cosserat IGA beam (horizontal) -----------------------------------------
beam_wy, beam_wz = 0.12, 0.15     # rectangular cross-section  (Y × Z)

iner_coss = fea.ChInertiaCosseratSimple()
iner_coss.SetAsRectangularSection(beam_wy, beam_wz, 2700)      # density

elastic_coss = fea.ChElasticityCosseratSimple()
elastic_coss.SetYoungModulus(72e9)
elastic_coss.SetShearModulusFromPoisson(0.35)
elastic_coss.SetAsRectangularSection(beam_wy, beam_wz)

section_coss = fea.ChSectionCosserat(iner_coss, elastic_coss)
section_coss.SetDrawThickness(beam_wy * 0.5, beam_wz)

builder_iga = fea.ChBuilderBeamIGA()
builder_iga.BuildBeam(mesh, section_coss, 30, vA, vC, chrono.VECT_X, 3)

# fix first node of the beam
builder_iga.GetLastBeamNodes()[0].SetFixed(True)

# keep references for later constraints
node_tip = builder_iga.GetLastBeamNodes()[65]    # tip (≈ right end)
node_mid = builder_iga.GetLastBeamNodes()[32]

# --- Euler beam (vertical) ---------------------------------------------------
hbeam_d = 0.05
section_vert = fea.ChBeamSectionAdvanced()
section_vert.SetDensity(2500)
section_vert.SetYoungModulus(75e9)
section_vert.SetShearModulusFromPoisson(0.25)
section_vert.SetRayleighDamping(0.0)
section_vert.SetAsCircularSection(hbeam_d)

builder_vert = fea.ChBuilderBeamEuler()
builder_vert.BuildBeam(mesh, section_vert, 10, vC + vd, vB + vd,
                       chrono.ChVectorD(1, 0, 0))      # local Y aligned with global X

node_top  = builder_vert.GetLastBeamNodes()[0]
node_down = builder_vert.GetLastBeamNodes()[-1]

# --- Euler beam (crank link) -------------------------------------------------
crankbeam_d = 0.06
section_crank = fea.ChBeamSectionAdvanced()
section_crank.SetDensity(2800)
section_crank.SetYoungModulus(75e9)
section_crank.SetShearModulusFromPoisson(0.25)
section_crank.SetRayleighDamping(0.0)
section_crank.SetAsCircularSection(crankbeam_d)

builder_crank = fea.ChBuilderBeamEuler()
builder_crank.BuildBeam(mesh, section_crank, 4, vG + vd, vB + vd,
                        chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))

node_crankG = builder_crank.GetLastBeamNodes()[0]
node_crankB = builder_crank.GetLastBeamNodes()[-1]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Constraints between bodies / nodes
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Revolute-like: keep node_top Z-axis parallel to node_tip Z-axis and coincident in X-Z plane
constr_bb = chrono.ChLinkMateParallel()
constr_bb.Initialize(node_top, node_tip, False,
                     node_top.Frame(), node_top.Frame())
constr_bb.SetConstrainedCoords(True, False, True, False, False, False)
sys.Add(constr_bb)

# Prismatic between crank node (G) and rigid crank (body_crank)
constr_cbd = chrono.ChLinkMatePrismatic()
constr_cbd.Initialize(node_crankG, body_crank, False,
                      node_crankG.Frame(), node_crankG.Frame())
constr_cbd.SetConstrainedCoords(True, True, True, True, True, True)
sys.Add(constr_cbd)

# Generic joint between bottom of vertical beam and bottom of crank beam
constr_bc = chrono.ChLinkMateGeneric()
constr_bc.Initialize(node_down, node_crankB, False,
                     node_crankB.Frame(), node_crankB.Frame())
constr_bc.SetConstrainedCoords(True, True, False, True, True, False)
sys.Add(constr_bc)

# small visual spheres to see where constraints act
constr_bb.AddVisualShape(chrono.ChVisualShapeSphere(0.02))
constr_bc.AddVisualShape(chrono.ChVisualShapeSphere(0.01))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Add mesh to the system
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mesh.SetAutomaticGravity(True)
sys.Add(mesh)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Visualisation of FEA fields
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
vis_beam = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
vis_beam.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_ELEM_BEAM_MZ)
vis_beam.SetColorscaleMinMax(-400, 400)
vis_beam.SetSmoothFaces(False)
vis_beam.SetWireframe(False)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(vis_beam)

vis_glyphs = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
vis_glyphs.SetFEMglyphType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.GlyphType_NODE_DOT_POS)
vis_glyphs.SetSymbolsThickness(0.005)
vis_glyphs.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)
vis_glyphs.SetZbufferHide(True)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(vis_glyphs)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Linear solver and time integrator
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkl_solver = mklsolver.ChSolverPardisoMKL()
sys.SetSolver(mkl_solver)

stepper = chrono.ChTimestepperHHT(sys)     # higher accuracy, less numerical damping
stepper.SetAlpha(-0.2)
stepper.SetMaxiters(50)
stepper.SetAbsTolerances(1e-10)
sys.SetTimestepper(stepper)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Irrlicht run-time visualisation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Beam mechanism – corrected version')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.jpg'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 1.0, -1.5))
vis.AddTypicalLights()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Main simulation loop
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
time_step = 0.002
while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()

    chronoirr.drawGrid(vis, 0.1, 0.1, 10, 10,
                       chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))

    vis.EndScene()
    sys.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
#
# Beam-buckling demo with FEA, custom motor, constraints and Irrlicht
#
# Author : <your-name>
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Prerequisites
#  • An up-to-date Chrono build that contains the modules:
#       chrono, chrono.irrlicht, chrono.fea
#  • Python 3.x
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

import math
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.fea    as fea

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Chrono system initialisation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())   # textures, fonts …
sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()                             # SMC = penalty contacts (unused here)

# basic environment
sys.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))           # gravity (downwards, Y axis)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Geometry, materials, mesh (FEA beam)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation units :  [m , kg , s , N]
beam_len   = 1.0                                       # 1 m long beam
beam_w     = 0.02                                      # 2 cm square cross-section
E          = 210e9                                     # Young [Pa] (steel)
G          = 80e9                                      # Shear [Pa]
rho        = 7800                                      # density [kg/m³]

#
# 2.1 Beam section
#
section = fea.ChBeamSectionAdvanced()
section.SetYoungModulus(E)
section.SetGwithPoissonRatio(E, 0.3)
section.SetDensity(rho)
section.SetAsRectangularSection(beam_w, beam_w, True)

#
# 2.2 Mesh container
#
mesh = fea.ChMesh()

#
# 2.3 Nodes and elements (Euler-Bernoulli or Timoshenko, choose Euler here)
#
n_elem = 20
dz     = beam_len / n_elem

# first node (x=0) is coincident with ground body later
nodes = []

for i in range(n_elem+1):
    node = fea.ChNodeFEAxyzrot( chrono.ChFrameD( chrono.ChVectorD( dz*i, 0, 0 ) ) )
    node.SetMass( rho * beam_w * beam_w * dz )         # simple lumped mass per node
    mesh.AddNode(node)
    nodes.append(node)

for i in range(n_elem):
    element = fea.ChElementBeamEuler()
    element.SetNodes( nodes[i], nodes[i+1] )
    element.SetSection( section )
    mesh.AddElement( element )

sys.Add(mesh)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Rigid bodies, constraints, custom motor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Ground body
ground = chrono.ChBody()
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
sys.Add(ground)

# Visual aid for ground
ground_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape()
ground_shape.GetBoxGeometry().Size = chrono.ChVectorD(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
ground.AddAsset(ground_shape)

# 3.2 Sliding body (acts as actuator platen compressing the beam)
platen = chrono.ChBody()
platen.SetMass(1.0)
platen.SetPos( chrono.ChVectorD( beam_len, 0, 0 ) )
sys.Add(platen)

# Cylinder visualisation
cyl = chrono.ChCylinderShape()
cyl.GetCylinderGeometry().p1 = chrono.ChVectorD(-0.02, -0.02, 0)
cyl.GetCylinderGeometry().p2 = chrono.ChVectorD( 0.02,  0.02, 0)
cyl.GetCylinderGeometry().rad = 0.03
platen.AddAsset(cyl)

# 3.3 Tie beam ends to rigid bodies
#     Node 0  -> ground;   Node n_elem -> platen
ground_constraint = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
ground_constraint.Initialize( nodes[0], ground )
sys.Add(ground_constraint)

platen_constraint = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
platen_constraint.Initialize( nodes[-1], platen )
sys.Add(platen_constraint)

# 3.4 Prismatic joint between ground and platen so platen moves along X only
prism = chrono.ChLinkLockPrismatic()
prism.Initialize( platen, ground,
                  chrono.ChCoordsysD( chrono.ChVectorD(beam_len, 0, 0),
                                      chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.pi/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,1)) ) )
sys.Add(prism)

# 3.5 Linear motor (prescribed relative displacement = compression)
linmot = chrono.ChLinkMotorLinearPosition()
linmot.Initialize( platen, ground, chrono.ChFrameD( chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0) ) )  # the same axis (X) is used

#
# Custom displacement function: start at t=0, move −delta over T seconds then hold
#
class CompressionFunction(chrono.ChFunction):
    def __init__(self, displacement=-0.02, ramp_time=0.5):
        chrono.ChFunction.__init__(self)
        self.disp = displacement
        self.tramp = ramp_time

    def Get_y(self, t):
        if t < self.tramp:
            return self.disp * (t/self.tramp)
        else:
            return self.disp

    def Get_y_dx(self, t):
        if t < self.tramp:
            return self.disp / self.tramp
        else:
            return 0.0

    def Get_y_dxdx(self, t):
        return 0.0

linmot.SetMotionFunction(CompressionFunction(displacement=-0.05, ramp_time=1.0))
sys.Add(linmot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Solver and integrator
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.1 Solver (use MKL if present, fallback to MINRES)
try:
    mkl = chrono.ChSolverMKL()
    mkl.SetVerbose(False)
    sys.SetSolver(mkl)
except:
    print("[INFO] MKL not available, switching to MINRES")
    minres = chrono.ChSolverMINRES()
```

• Finite-Element Beam  
  – An `ChMesh` container holds Euler beam elements (`ChElementBeamEuler`) built from `ChNodeFEAxyzrot` nodes.  
  – Section parameters (E, G, density, and geometry) are set through `ChBeamSectionAdvanced`.

• Boundary conditions / constraints  
  – Node 0 is rigidly fixed to the ground; the last node is rigidly fixed to the moving platen.  
  – A prismatic joint allows the platen to translate only along the beam axis.  
  – A linear motor (`ChLinkMotorLinearPosition`) is attached on the same axis to prescribe a controlled compression; a custom subclass of `ChFunction` generates a ramp-down displacement (negative = shortening) over 1 s and then keeps it constant.

• Solver & integrator  
  – MKL (direct) is preferred; if not available, MINRES (iterative) is configured.  
  – The HHT α-method provides good robustness for stiff FEA problems such as buckling.

• Visualisation  
  – Irrlicht renders the beam, ground, and platen in real time.  
  – `AssetBindAll()` and `AssetUpdateAll()` automatically attach visualization shapes to FEA items and rigid bodies.
